description: Day trips from a base city to other covered cities and towns nearby, e.g. "day trips from Florence" or "a day trip from Munich for castles". Ranks destinations by distance, fit with the traveler's interests and periods, and fame, and lists what to see there in one day. Distances are straight-line; travel times are not included because trains, mountains and ferries change them a lot. Only covered cities are listed.

hours_on_site.description: Hours to spend at the destination; sets how many highlights are listed.

language.description: Language of names and descriptions: en, es, fr, de, tr or zh.

max_distance_km.description: Furthest straight-line distance to consider. Default 250.

periods.description: Historical periods to favour, e.g. ["byzantine"] or ["roman","renaissance"].

name: find_day_trips
title: Find day trips
